scope: fallback counting on fixed-frame flock video, not swiftlet-specific accuracy
review: 66 frames at 0.4-second spacing across whole clip; detail at 0.2 seconds from 7.8 through 14.2 seconds; no model predictions used
referenceAnchor: visible body center; wings touching line alone do not count
minBoxNote: Original-resolution short side; all visually counted birds are clearly larger; not a filter applied to old training data
limitations: Single 25.96-second segment rather than approximately one-minute segments
Body center reference can differ from predicted whole-box center
TV5 recount not performed; no claim that human count is verified
